content.title: Where is Lamar Odom now as 'Untold' Netflix documentary drops?
content.text: March 31, 2026, 8:40 a.m. ETLamar Odom is the subject of a new Netflix documentary: Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom, telling the story behind the former 14-year NBA star and his struggles with addiction.With a title like that, it can be a little confusing, so we're here to answer questions you might have about the two-time NBA champion as you watch the documentary.The first thing we can answer for you: Where is Lamar Odom now? For that answer, you should read USA TODAY's interview with him. He's 60 days sober when Erin Jensen spoke with him and he had this to say about the documentary: "I was telling my girlfriend on the way here, it's like swimming in a cesspool of trauma. And I'm trying to get out of it, but the story reels me back into that pool every time. But I just know I'm bigger than the situation, and I hope to help a lot of people by giving my testimony. Not just with the story, but just in life, that we can all overcome addiction."Here's more info on Odom now:Is Lamar Odom alive?He is!Did Lamar Odom die?Full disclosure: I haven't watched the documentary yet, but that title could refer to the fact that Odom was found non-responsive at Love Ranch in 2015. He's since recovered after months at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center.How old is Lamar Odom?He's 46 years old now.Who is Lamar Odom's wife now?He's not married. He says he has a girlfriend but has not disclosed who she is.How did Lamar Odom's son Jayden die?Jayden was six months old when he died from Sudden Infant Death Syndrome, or SIDS.
